body_lead: HYDERABAD: With AI being the buzzword in every field, its usage is increasingly gaining currency and acceptance. The state’s Commercial Tax Department (CTD) officials have been unofficially using AI in their work for drafting discrepancy reports, notices, orders, and other proceedings. They have also been using it for analysing, translating and summarising case records.
